actions_taken: Inspected the contract and consumer notes. No workspace changes or serialization behavior changes were made.
question: Should new clients continue receiving v3 names (`account_id`, `created_at`), or should the migration owner approve switching them to legacy names (`accountId`, `createdAt`)?
reason: The public wire contract exposes account_id and created_at to deployed North/mobile, whereas South/importer consumes legacy accountId and createdAt; no migration owner or date is recorded.
recommendation: Preserve the v3 names until the migration owner decides.
